ranking.name: La Quinta by Wyndham New Orleans Downtown

text.text_excerpt: The location of this hotel was absolutely perfect for everything we wanted to do. I am so glad we lucked out with this find, especially during St. Paddy's day weekend and the first weekend of spring break. I was nervous that being downtown we would be too far away from the "action" when we were actually perfectly situated in the middle of it. The lobby is nice and we made ourselves quite comfortable there after we checked out and we're waiting for our ride to the airport. They also have a small business center so that you may print your boarding passes if needed. The breakfast room is nice as well even though we didn't eat breakfast at the hotel. We had an excellent stay here! One of the best values we saw, and everything was great. Great location (very close to the French Quarter hub & the aquarium), convenient parking available (and valet parking if needed), very friendly & helpful staff, and a pleasant, clean room. Continental breakfast was nothing amazing, but not bad, either. I've seen much poorer selections. Again, the staff was great! Everyone seemed genuinely happy to have us there and happy to help with anything they could. The only complaint I have is that the particular room we got did not have a regular door in the bathroom, nor a ventilating fan. I have stayed here twice and have never had a bad experience. The one time we had a problem with the door lock on the room...someone was up to fix it within 10 minutes. Very close to everything downtown and far enough from the Quarter to be mayhem free. The rooms have always been clean and the staff helpful, efficient and friendly. It's a great budget hotel in my experience. Well worth checking out.
